rows.note: Use 名 as the all-purpose spoken noun for the name of a work, including a book, song, or film.

example.english: The title of this film is quite unusual.
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 ming4 gei2 dak6 bit6

rows.note: Use 字幕 for written titles, credits, or captions displayed on a film, video, or performance.

example.english: The title credits at the end show the director's name.
example.traditional: 片尾字幕寫住導演個名。
example.jyutping: pin3 mei5 zi6 mok6 se2 zyu6 dou6 jin2 go3 meng4

rows.note: Use 稱謂 for an honorific or form of address such as 先生 or 博士, rather than for a work's name.

example.english: In formal settings, use the appropriate title.
example.traditional: 正式場合要用適當嘅稱謂。
example.jyutping: zing3 sik1 coeng4 hap6 jiu3 jung6 sik1 dong3 ge3 cing1 wai6

rows.note: Use 冠軍 for the championship status or title awarded to the winner of a sporting competition.

example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 lo2 dou2 gun1 gwan1
